messages:
maya: RFC follow-up: we need to pick gateway vs ingest recode for cohort + cost provenance. Keep this thread short.
kai: Two patterns: gateway recode (early billing key) or ingest recode (centralized, no SDK churn). Tradeoffs below.
anika: Gateway sketch: compact header like `X-RD-P: o=acme|c=smp-v2|r=gw|t=1700000000` -> ingest stores both compact key + provenance blob.
jordan: Query risk: cohort variants -> cardinality spike. Add cohort_normalize() + small mapping table during rollout.
lee: Plan backfill/mapping fallback if semantics change. Rollout: non-billing tenants -> internal -> staged %.
sami: Finance prefers gateway recode + orig provenance for audits. Perf checks needed.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout cadence 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 99p latency gates.
maya: Consensus leans gateway recode + provenance + normalize helper. Actions: anika RFC, kai SQL helper, lee rollout/SLO, jordan cardinality numbers, sami perf tests. Post RFC link here when ready.
